route_status.proven_scope: The exact Godot 4.7.2-stable probe ran once with an isolated profile and reported NURSERY result ALL OK. Source tracing shows the live career route creates OperaNurseryCatch for Nursery, shows it for CATCH BABIES, and sizes it to the activity surface (scripts/opera_career_world_2d.gd:1337-1345, 2654-2686, 2873-2877). The probe proves no-input misses, safe landings, post-miss mercy and five catches after its scripted steering sequence.
route_status.route_gaps: The probe instantiates the act directly, opens the catch task through _open_armed_task, and calls steer_to/._process rather than navigating a fresh-save Castle route or injecting ordinary screen-touch/drag events (scripts/probe_opera_nursery.gd:11-41, 62-96, 180-184). Headless rendering is not Mobile visual evidence. No physical touch, Lenovo Tab M11 latency/frame pacing, child comprehension/appeal, or owner acceptance was observed. Probe wall time is not gameplay time.

code_constants.value: A press or drag refreshes input_live_t for 2.0 seconds; the catch surface accepts screen press and drag events (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:22, 89-92, 106-127).
code_constants.scope: Source timer and event handling; not measured device responsiveness.

code_constants.value: Babies catch at normalized y=0.74 and miss at y=0.91; initial fall speed is 0.205 normalized screen heights per simulated second and bottoms at 0.115 (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:20-21, 139-148, 192-203).
code_constants.scope: The initial interval between catch and pillow thresholds is about 0.83 simulated seconds (0.17/0.205); at the speed floor it is about 1.48 seconds (0.17/0.115). These are calculations from code, not rendered timings.

code_constants.value: The assigned probe advances catch physics in 0.12-second steps and steers to the lowest faller on every iteration (scripts/probe_opera_nursery.gd:91-96).
code_constants.scope: Scripted helper cadence; it does not model a child's finger motion or event cadence.

code_constants.value: After two misses, subsequent drops steer to 0.035–0.11 normalized units from the catcher, their speed is reduced by 0.011 per miss down to 0.115, and catch width grows by 0.013 per miss up to 0.22 (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:131-148, 192).
code_constants.scope: Code-defined mercy; visual ease and perceived difficulty were not observed.

timing.assumptions: No child-paced duration was observed. The receipt records 10.174 seconds of probe process time, not nursery play time.

tactile.target_size: The catch Control is 392×232 canvas pixels in the phase layout and uses MOUSE_FILTER_STOP (scripts/opera_career_world_2d.gd:2871-2876; scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:44-46). Any point in the control maps the cradle's normalized x position, clamped to 0.10–0.90 (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:89-108). This generous input surface exceeds the 110×110 project target guidance in source dimensions, but visible scale, panel placement, edge alignment and overlap at supported aspects were not rendered or measured on a device.
tactile.press_response: A valid press immediately updates catcher_x/input_live_t and queues redraw; a catch increments progress, updates the phase panel, calls truthful success feedback and bounces both actors (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:89-92, 152-159; scripts/opera_career_world_2d.gd:3665-3689). The probe observes state changes only; it does not establish visible response within two rendered frames or sound audibility.
tactile.drag_hold_release: A screen press places the cradle; screen drags continue to reposition it. A release does not clear the 2-second input window, but merely holding still cannot keep that timer fresh (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:89-92, 110-125). The actual contact band is y=0.74 through y=0.91, after which a miss safely lands. No physical drag, hold, release, or timing tolerance was tested.
tactile.ownership: The catch Control stops mouse-filter propagation and accepts screen press/drag while active (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:44-46, 110-120). This controller has no local touch-ID owner field; the session did not test concurrent fingers or the surrounding router's ownership in this overlay.
tactile.cancellation: The catch controller does not handle a canceled touch specially; its freshness timer naturally expires after 2 seconds, and stop() deactivates it and clears fallers/safe landings (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:81-86, 110-127). Actual focus loss, pause, route exit during an owned touch and resume were not exercised by the focused probe.

play_appeal.agency: Hypothesis: moving a visible cradle under falling babies gives the child a clear caretaker role, and each intentional catch produces saved-in-cradle/actor feedback. The probe verifies state causality, not that the child reads the falling trajectory or the mercy cue.
play_appeal.variety: For this focus, babies sway, lanes vary, and two can fall simultaneously after two catches (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:131-149, 172-191). Those changes may make the task lively; their readability and whether simultaneous fallers feel fair remain unobserved.
play_appeal.world_response: Catches retain a baby visibly in the shared cradle and trigger progress/actor response; misses display a briefly fading safe landing, bounce Faron and queue her miss cue (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:152-169, 241-255, 284-291; scripts/opera_career_world_2d.gd:3665-3701). The probe asserts safe state/phase progression and exact cue path, not rendered acting or audible playback.
play_appeal.replay: The focused probe proves this catch phase can complete after misses and continue to FEED, but does not test a visible ordinary replay/return route or whether the child wants another round.
play_appeal.concrete_test_or_proposal: On a consented Lenovo Tab M11 session, enter through the ordinary Nursery route and offer no timing coaching. Observe whether the child learns to slide the cradle with the falling baby and continues finger movement/repositioning near contact, whether a short early tap is mistaken for a complete catch, how two simultaneous babies are handled, and whether the pillow-safe miss plus Faron's response invites an independent retry. Record accidental misses, actual touch response and the child's own words/actions; do not infer appeal from this scripted probe.

play_sequence.input: Open the Nursery catch task through its visible room/station route; listen to Faron's instruction and look for the cradle and falling baby.
play_sequence.wait: Wait for the task cue to finish and for the first baby to become visible; this review did not measure cue or spawn time.
play_sequence.basis: The active catch phase tells the child to slide the cradle under five falling babies and says pillows keep misses safe (scripts/opera_career_world_2d.gd:336-341); phase prompt uses the active voice/cue (scripts/opera_career_world_2d.gd:2746-2785).

play_sequence.input: Press in the catch area under the baby, then keep a finger moving in a short drag as the baby descends; reposition the cradle if its lane changes.
play_sequence.wait: A press/drag refreshes a 2-second input window. The probe's repeated 0.12-second steering is not a child cadence; watch whether the child naturally refreshes input near the catch band.
play_sequence.basis: Input mapping and timer are in scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:89-127; catch only evaluates while input_live_t is positive at y≥0.74 (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:172-203).

play_sequence.input: Keep the cradle under the baby through the lower catch band and observe the baby settle into the cradle.
play_sequence.wait: The source catch band spans normalized y=0.74–0.91. At initial speed, the calculated interval is about 0.83 simulated seconds; actual on-screen duration is unmeasured.
play_sequence.basis: Thresholds and catch state are scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:20-21, 192-203; retained caught babies are drawn at :284-291.

play_sequence.input: If a baby lands on the pillows, let the child see the safe landing and try moving the cradle for the next baby.
play_sequence.wait: Allow the miss feedback to appear; its safe-landing entry lasts 1.25 source seconds and fades near the end (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:161-170, 248-255). Do not treat this as a measured device duration.
play_sequence.basis: The probe deliberately waits without input until at least two misses, confirms no automatic catch and confirms the phase stays active (scripts/probe_opera_nursery.gd:82-89).

play_sequence.input: After two misses, continue steering toward the next baby's lane rather than waiting for a catch to happen automatically.
play_sequence.wait: Observe how the altered lane/speed feels; no fixed child wait is prescribed. Mercy remains active and still requires fresh touch.
play_sequence.basis: After two misses the spawn lane moves near the catcher with an alternating offset and reduced speed (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:131-149); the probe catches five only after calling steer_to throughout its loop (scripts/probe_opera_nursery.gd:91-103).

play_sequence.input: Let the child respond to the two falling babies that can overlap after early catches, using the single cradle movement to prioritize the lower one.
play_sequence.wait: Observe one drop/catch cycle before prompting; no simultaneous-faller comprehension or pacing was established by the probe.
play_sequence.basis: At two catches, up to two fallers may coexist (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:178-181); lowest_baby_x returns the largest y (scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:95-103).

play_sequence.input: After five catches, let the cozy cradle and cooperative curtain call settle, then offer the choice to continue or leave without asking the child to repeat.
play_sequence.wait: The caller holds the completion scene for 0.8 source seconds before phase advance; this is a code value, not a rendered/device measurement (scripts/opera_career_world_2d.gd:3685-3689).
play_sequence.basis: The probe checks five catches, cooperative win, cozy-babies cheer and touch-layer restoration on exit (scripts/probe_opera_nursery.gd:102-103, 154-168).

observations.title: A recent cradle press or drag is required at the catch moment, while mercy still asks for steering
evidence: scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:89-92 refreshes input_live_t to 2.0 seconds on each steer.
scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:172-203 decrements that timer and requires it to remain positive when a baby crosses CATCH_Y; a static early tap cannot keep input fresh indefinitely.
scripts/probe_opera_nursery.gd:91-96 invokes steer_to(target) on every 0.12-second physics step, so its catch-success leg does not establish that ordinary touch cadence is comfortable.

scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:131-149 makes later drops slower and closer after misses, while still preserving deliberate catches; the probe's passive leg confirms no catch occurs without fresh input at scripts/probe_opera_nursery.gd:82-89.
observations.reproduction: Read the timer/condition and compare with the focused probe loop: the probe continuously steers every 0.12 simulated seconds. A source-level reproduction is an early cradle press followed by no further drag for more than 2 seconds; the input-live gate will have expired before a later catch unless renewed. This is not a measured child/device miss.
observations.child_impact: A child may think placing the cradle once is enough, then see a baby safely land while the current instruction says to slide under falling babies. The play loop likely asks for continued finger motion or a timely later drag, but actual discoverability and tolerance are unknown.
observations.proposed_repair: No confirmed defect is established from this code-only comparison. On device, observe whether children naturally keep or renew the drag during descent. If an unintended gap appears, consider maintaining the live window while the owning finger remains down, with cancellation/ownership rules preserved; tune only from measured play.
observations.acceptance_test: Using real screen-touch press, stationary hold, drag, release and canceled-touch events on the exact build, verify a child can understand when to refresh movement, stale input never catches later, and a recent intentional drag catches within the generous cradle area. Confirm prompt visible response and repeat with target-device/child evidence.

observations.title: Misses preserve completion and widen the next catch opportunity without passive awards
evidence: scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:131-149 applies near-catcher alternating spawn lanes and slower drops after two misses; :161-170 records a pillow-safe landing without incrementing caught.
scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:192-203 increases catch width by miss count but only calls _catch while fresh input is live.
scripts/probe_opera_nursery.gd:82-103 waits for at least two passive misses, verifies zero catches and active phase, then uses explicit one-finger steering to catch five babies.

audit/cycles/luna-playtest-20261012/runtime/L21/attempt_1/probe.log:19-21 reports the no-self-catch, safe-mercy and five-catch assertions; final line is NURSERY|result: ALL OK. Receipt records PASS and the exact Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf.
observations.reproduction: The probe advances the controller without input until missed≥2 and verifies caught==0 and phase_index==1, then steers to the lowest faller until caught==5. The final result is a scripted assertion, not a physical play observation.
observations.child_impact: A mistake cannot lose a baby or end the job, and the game still requires an intentional cradle move. This offers a recovery path while preserving agency in code.
observations.proposed_repair: No behavior change indicated by these assertions. Retain pillow-safe recovery and check in an observed child session that mercy is legible and does not feel like a sudden difficulty jump.
observations.acceptance_test: On target device, allow two misses, then steer one-fingered to catch the slowed/nearby drops. Confirm babies remain safe, progress only follows intentional catches, and the child can recover without adult verbal direction.

observations.title: The controller exposes a large activity surface, but ordinary touch ownership and rendered alignment are unproved
evidence: scripts/opera_career_world_2d.gd:2871-2876 sizes catch surface to the visible phase surface (392×232 canvas px in code).
scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:44-46 sets MOUSE_FILTER_STOP; :106-127 maps screen press and drag local x to cradle position.
scripts/probe_opera_nursery.gd:91-96 calls the convenience method steer_to directly, not _gui_input; its geometry assertions do not exercise event routing or cancellation.
audit/cycles/luna-playtest-20261012/runtime/L21/attempt_1/receipt.json states headless=true, rendered_mobile_acceptance=false, status=PASS; the probe log contains no rendered/input-device evidence.
observations.reproduction: Trace the live phase surface placement and input mapping, then note that the assigned positive loop bypasses event dispatch. Runtime evidence confirms only a headless engine check; it does not sample touch position, visible bounds, cancellation, competing touches, or latency.
observations.child_impact: A broad source rectangle appears forgiving, but any mismatch between the painted mobile/cradle and responsive surface, or a cancellation/second-finger route issue, could make a correct child gesture feel ignored. This session cannot establish whether either occurs.
observations.proposed_repair: No repair is justified from this internal probe. Add no new test here; route an already planned rendered/device review through the ordinary station and exercise press, drag, release, cancel, pause and second finger against the actual visible cradle.
observations.acceptance_test: At both supported aspects and on Lenovo Tab M11, enter from the visible career route and compare the painted catch area with the responsive surface; use one finger, cancel/release, try a second finger, and verify the cradle follows the owning touch with visible response within two rendered frames and no stale catch.

observations.title: Catch feedback and cooperative ending are asserted as state, not independently reviewed as a visible performance
evidence: scripts/opera_nursery_catch.gd:152-159 retains the caught baby and emits quality; :284-291 draws caught babies in the cradle.
scripts/opera_career_world_2d.gd:3665-3689 updates progress, calls success feedback, bounces Roshan/Faron and holds the completion beat for 0.8 seconds.
scripts/probe_opera_nursery.gd:102-103 and :154-164 assert five catches, cooperative completion and the cozy-babies cheer.
audit/cycles/luna-playtest-20261012/runtime/L21/attempt_1/probe.log:28-30 reports the cooperative show, cheer and touch-layer exit checks; receipt rendered_mobile_acceptance=false.
observations.reproduction: The probe completes the catching phase with direct steering and verifies later show completion/cheer. Source draws retained babies and schedules actor motion, but no screenshot or listener confirms visible contact, mobile composition, motion quality, or actual audio playback.
observations.child_impact: If rendered as intended, the baby settling in the cradle and Faron/Roshan celebrating make the care action's result concrete. This session does not establish visual legibility, performance readability, or audible encouragement.
observations.proposed_repair: No change indicated by the state assertions. Keep the unresolved Opera visual/child/owner gates open and compare the actual catch and settle frames against the mobile nursery art at supported aspects.
observations.acceptance_test: Capture the phase from an ordinary route at both aspects; review a full catch through settle and curtain call for truthful baby/cradle contact, visible actor response, unobscured staging and exact audible Faron/Roshan cues, then collect separate device, child and owner evidence.

strengths.claim: The catch phase uses a dedicated Nursery controller, three baby textures and a borderless room-visible presentation; it has no-fail metadata and explicit input freshness.
Zero input cannot catch babies, while safe pillow landings, mercy and deliberate five-baby completion all passed the assigned runtime assertions.
strengths.evidence: scripts/probe_opera_nursery.gd:82-103; runtime/L21/attempt_1/probe.log:19-21, final NURSERY|result: ALL OK.

strengths.claim: The catch success contributes progress and a cooperative cozy-babies ending, and exit restores the touch layer in the tested path.

acceptance_gaps: The single isolated Godot 4.7.2 probe passed, but its catch-positive path directly calls steer_to every 0.12 simulated seconds; this does not test a natural finger cadence, ordinary GUI event route, or a child's understanding of when to move.

The 392×232 source Control is generously sized, but rendered Mobile composition, aspect-ratio coordinate alignment, two-frame response, target-device frame pacing/latency, touch ownership/cancellation, and audibility remain untested.

No observed child session establishes comprehension, comfort, fairness of simultaneous fallers, emotional response to misses, appeal, session length or replay choice. Owner acceptance remains pending under DL-QA-06.
voice_status: The probe checks expected Faron/Roshan cue paths and queue increments (scripts/probe_opera_nursery.gd:193-215, 219-250), but this run did not play/listen to or approve any recording. No voice asset was modified.
